props.name: dateFormat
props.description: Specify date format for UI display
props.rawType: 'MMM dd, yyyy' | 'MM/dd/yyyy' | 'dd/MM/yyyy' | 'yyyy/MM/dd' | 'MMM dd yyyy' | 'dd MMM yyyy'

props.name: datePickerId
props.description: Internal ID only for labeling date picker popup

props.name: days
props.description: Container for current days in month

props.name: disabledMaxDate
props.description: Maximum date for disabled dates (format: yyyy/mm/dd)

props.name: disabledMinDate
props.description: Minimum date for disabled dates (format: yyyy/mm/dd)

props.name: fullDateFormat
props.description: Specify "full" date format for aria role

props.name: isDayShortHand
props.description: Show the day of the week as a short hand, e.g. "M" for Monday

props.name: monthSelectorLabel
props.description:
Accessible name for the month/year picker popup.

The popup is `role="dialog"` and its content is a grid of year headings and
month buttons, so it had no accessible name at all — a screen reader
announced "dialog" and nothing else. Settable rather than hardcoded so it
can be localised, matching `timeSelectorLabel` / `cancelLabel` on
al-date-time-picker.

props.name: multiYear
props.description: Amount of years to go before and after the current date

props.name: setActiveDate
props.description: Set a specific date to be active

props.name: showMonthPopup
props.description: Value to track month picker display

props.name: startOnMonday
props.description: Start the day of the week on Monday

events.name: onCalendarChange
events.description: Fired when a date is selected. Detail: `{ value, rawDate }` — the date formatted per `dateFormat`, and the underlying `Date` object.

slots.name: after
slots.description: If content is slotted, it will override the default "next button" icon

slots.name: before
slots.description: If content is slotted, it will override the default "previous button" icon
